title: Extract Store into its Own Technology
description: Extract/Extend/Refactor store into its own technology. Store is a local-first, non-blocking, client-side, in-memory store (currently the DocumentVcsStore/Backbone/BlobStore/Studio regions inside vcs/rs/lib.rs). All backbones (file, folder, remote) are hot-swappable at runtime to store. Ensure it works cleanly with vcs (version-graph algebra), pack+dsl (serialization), protocol+op (op algebra), and hub+db (server). Full facade: apps depend on store, never vcs directly; dsl derive macros flip ::vcs:: -> ::store::. Also rename the colliding compose/client/bin/store sidecar to compose-gql. Approved plan: /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/extract-extend-refactor-store-into-its-cozy-ullman.md
summary:
Extracted the local-first, non-blocking, in-memory document store out of `vcs` into a new top-level `store` technology, per the approved plan (full facade + compose-gql rename).

**Architecture landed**: `protocol ← vcs (slim version-graph algebra) ← store (DocumentStore/Backbone/BlobStore/Studio/serialization seam) ← store_sync (FolderSqliteStorage/FolderTextStorage/actor, renamed from framework/sync) ← store_worker (renamed from framework/sync/worker) ← framework/apps`. Apps now depend on `store`, never `vcs`, for anything beyond raw version-graph data (Author/Change/Checkpoint/Alternative/DocumentVcs/VcsError/content_addressed_checkpoint_id/apply_operation/CollectionDiff/CollectionOperation — the only things left in `vcs`).

**Key renames**: `DocumentVcsStore→store::DocumentStore`, `DocumentVcsEnvelope→DocumentEnvelope`, `DocumentVcsCommand→DocumentCommand`, `create_document_vcs_envelope→create_document_envelope`, `StudioVcsHost→StudioHost`. `dsl_derive` flipped to emit `::store::DocumentDsl`/`::store::DocumentPack`/`::store::TextError` (was `::vcs::`). ~90 dependent crates repointed (`vcs` dep → `store` dep, `vcs::X` → `store::X` for every moved symbol) via a scripted sweep + manual fixups for edge cases (compose's own internal `mod vcs` collision, dropped-`pub` on split use-blocks, nested-brace use statements). `db_engine`'s `vcs` Cargo feature now also pulls in `store` (kept the live-store-backed checkpoint-id minting rather than the deeper pure-function rewrite my plan aspired to — a reasonable scope cut, noted below). Compose's colliding `compose-store` HTTP/GraphQL sidecar renamed to `compose-gql` (crate, npm package, binary, `COMPOSE_GQL_PORT` env var, `composeGqlReady` wire field, launch.json entry, and the .NET/Grasshopper/Python consumers).

**Verification**: `cargo check --workspace --all-targets` — 0 errors. Targeted suites: vcs 6/6, store 70/70 (native+wasm32, real wasm-pack release build), store_sync 19/19 (incl. 5 relocated folder/blob-store tests), store_worker wasm-pack build, compose-gql compiles, os/core vitest 38/38 (incl. wire-fixture byte-identity canary — proves TS↔Rust wire contract survived). Plugin registry regen: zero diff (33 plugins/50 playgrounds). Full `cargo test --workspace` (excluding the unrelated `mathematical` family, which has pre-existing hangs — see below): 412 passed, 12 failed — every failure traced via diff-range/content analysis to pre-existing, unrelated causes (a repo-wide icon-catalog generation bug, pre-existing `compose` GraphQL "wip" staging test failures, a Postgres-testcontainer test needing Docker, and fixture/geometry assertions in files where my only edits were identical-behavior import-path renames). None are caused by this refactor.

**Follow-ups flagged, not fixed here** (out of scope / requires human action):
- AGENTS.md files are never edited by agents (repo rule) — needs a human pass: new `store/AGENTS.md`, slim `vcs/AGENTS.md` (still describes the old DocumentVcsStore/Backbone shape), relocate+rewrite `compose/client/bin/store/AGENTS.md` → `compose/client/bin/gql/AGENTS.md`, fix stale `compose-store` mentions in `compose/AGENTS.md:502`, `compose/client/lib/net/AGENTS.md`, `compose/client/ui/gh/AGENTS.md`.
- Spawned a separate background task for a hanging test in the unrelated `mathematical_cas`/`mathematical_polynomial` crates (100+ min CPU, blocks any full-workspace test run).
- `db_engine`'s `VcsVersionGraph` still drives a live `store::DocumentStore` rather than the pure content-addressed-id-minting rewrite my plan described — functionally correct and tested, but a deeper simplification is possible later.
